description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class 'AbstractInstallerController' which is part of the OrangeHRM installer module. It manages HTTP responses and handles installation-related requests, including response management and access control based on installation status.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerController
classes.description: An abstract controller class for handling installation-related HTTP requests, response management, and access control.

methods.name: getNewResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Response object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the current response object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object, validating the type to be Response, RedirectResponse, or null.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming requests, checks installation status, and manages response accordingly, either returning an error or proceeding to execute the request.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: An abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to process the request.
